name: Debug broken VBA and VB.NET macros
description: Users asked to debug and fix errors in existing VBA or VB.NET macros that failed to execute correctly due to runtime exceptions, syntax mistakes, or incorrect logic in spreadsheet and form automation tasks. These requests primarily focused on resolving specific troubleshooting issues, such as object variable errors, data type mismatches, and functional bugs preventing scripts from performing intended operations like copying data, manipulating cells, or interacting with external applications.
